in_sanskrit.name: Biri
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Fertility and Water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biri एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Biri is a Hindu name that originates from the Sanskrit and Hindi languages. It is derived from the name of the goddess of fertility and water, Bhirani. The name Biri signifies the power and abundance of nature, particularly in the areas of growth and nourishment. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
